Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the film "The First Seven Years" as a 1930 Our Gang short comedy. This is a hallucination; the famous film "The First Seven Years" is a 1960 Soviet/Russian drama directed by Grigori Chukhrai. The Our Gang short is titled "The First Seven Years" only in some contexts or is a confusion with a different title, but the primary film by that exact title known in cinema history is the 1960 classic. This fundamental error in identifying the correct film and its release year (1960 vs 1930) invalidates the subsequent comparison. The Planner failed to disambiguate the title before instructing the WebSurfer to search, leading to the retrieval of incorrect data.
